```{r Setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

```{r}

M1_F2 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/clean_data/aut26/thoa_identite_notag.csv", show_col_types = F)

C4_L0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_fa_04_couple_04.sas7bdat")
```

```{r}


empty_cols_C4_L0 <- C4_L0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(C4_L0))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_C4_L0$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
C4_L1 <- C4_L0 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%  
  select(-c("tab_db",
            "fa_type")) %>% 
  select(fa_date_creation, couple_date_creation, id_date_creation, id_anonymat, 
         id_sep, id_date_nais, id_sexe, sf_couple_1an, couple_sf_couple_1an,
           sf_conjt_prenom, sf_conjt_sexe, sf_conjt_mois_nais, sf_an_conjt_nais,
           sf_conjt_an_nais, sf_nature_union, sf_conjt_mois_union, sf_conjt_an_union,
           sf_conjt_muco, sf_interromp, sf_interromp_par, sf_mois_interromp, sf_an_interromp,
           sf_raison_muco, sf_conjt_enf, commentaires_fam) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_module = case_when(
      is.na(id_date_creation) ~ id_anonymat,
      !is.na(id_sep) ~ str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11)
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_keep = case_when(
      !is.na(id_sep) ~ str_sub(id_sep, 1, 5)
    ),
    .after = id_module
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    sf_conjt_prenom = str_to_upper(sf_conjt_prenom),
    sf_conjt_prenom = replace_when(
      sf_conjt_prenom,
      sf_conjt_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )



# rm(list = c("empty_cols_C4_L0", "vars_vides", "C4_L0"))
```
